def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            todo = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while todo:
                y, x = todo.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); todo.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = {(y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in cells}
            bh, bw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            # Flood the background from the bounding-box edge. Enclosed zeroes
            # mark a hollow object, which moves to the top; solid objects go down.
            exterior = set()
            stack = [(y,x) for y in range(bh) for x in range(bw)
                     if (y,x) not in shape and (y == 0 or x == 0 or y == bh-1 or x == bw-1)]
            exterior.update(stack)
            while stack:
                y,x = stack.pop()
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < bh and 0 <= nx < bw and (ny,nx) not in shape and (ny,nx) not in exterior:
                        exterior.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            hollow = any((y,x) not in shape and (y,x) not in exterior for y in range(bh) for x in range(bw))
            objects.append((cells, r0, bh, hollow))

    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def place(obj, top):
        cells, r0, bh, _ = obj
        starts = range(h-bh+1) if top else range(h-bh, -1, -1)
        for start in starts:
            if all(out[start+y-r0][x] == 0 for y,x in cells):
                for y,x in cells:
                    out[start+y-r0][x] = grid[y][x]
                return
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if o[3]), key=lambda o:(o[1], min(x for _,x in o[0]))):
        place(obj, True)
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if not o[3]), key=lambda o:(-o[1], -min(x for _,x in o[0]))):
        place(obj, False)
    return out
